newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end weaker, new lows hit across board.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end weaker, new lows hit across board.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures fell to fresh life-of-contract lows across the board and closed lower for the fourth consecutive session, in brisk volume.
Market sources blamed ongoing losses on weak technicals and a fundamental picture weighted down by strong world production and slack offtake.

Typically, prices climb higher during this time of year as cold weather moves into the Florida citrus belt. But recent warm temperatures have snuffed out any potential rally, putting additional pressure on an already weak market, analysts said.
Technically, the charts show more room on the downside.

The most-active March contract closed down 0.70 cents at 91.65 cents, traded 93.25 to 91.50, a new contract low. Spot January went out 0.65 lower at 88.20 cents, having hit a life-of-contract low of 88.20 cents.
The deferred contracts ended 1.75 to 0.50 weaker.
